messages:
maya_sales: Customer (large payments co) requests EU-only POC + UK addendum. Requirements: BYO-HSM, full EU/UK subprocessors list, and a contractual line that inference logs remain in-region. Any immediate blockers?
dan_se: No hard blocker. Need load profile and model type. Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoffs matter for BYO-HSM and control-plane locality.
maya_sales: Load: steady 60 qps, spikes 250 qps during settlement windows. Short chat (avg 80 tokens). p95 target ~300ms.
tara_security: BYO-HSM is only on Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can offer envelope keys but not HSM. Also need to prepare SOC2 + DPIA + subprocessors CSV for procurement. Full control-plane geo guarantees require legal sign-off and dedicated control-plane.
paul_ops: Ops subprocessors (EU/UK): aws-eu-west-1, aws-eu-west-2, gcp-europe-west1, azure-northeurope, fastcdn-ie, logstore-eu. I'll export attestations to PRESALES-3309.
respondbot: Ticket PRESALES-3309 created. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/presales-eu-uk.
sophie_ae: Procurement asked for sample routing policy and a short appendix sentence for the contract. Can someone drop both?
dan_se: Routing sample (presales):
```
routing_policy:
  tenant: payments-co
  data_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-west-2]
  control_plane_mode: dedicated-eu-uk  # requires dedicated purchase
  kms_mode: byo-hsm
  telemetry_level: minimal
  fallthrough: deny
```
dan_se: Appendix sample (starter): "Redwood will process and retain inference logs and model artifacts only within the Customer-specified EU/UK regions. Control-plane telemetry may be restricted by mutual agreement when a Dedicated or Private control-plane is procured." Tara/legal to refine.
tara_security: I'll prepare SOC2 + DPIA + subprocessors CSV and a legal-approved appendix draft by EOD tomorrow. Also note: hosted pinning can limit data plane egress but cannot fully guarantee control-plane locality.
paul_ops: Perf note: to hit 250 qps spikes with p95 <300ms for short contexts, recommend reserved 2x A10 or 1x A100 + warm KV cache. If they want cheaper hosted with caveats we can do pinning but highlight telemetry caveat.
maya_sales: Action items: 1) paul attach subprocessors + perf sizing to PRESALES-3309 (today). 2) tara draft legal appendix + attachments (EOD tomorrow). 3) dan produce two pricing scenarios: Hosted+pin (with caveats) and Dedicated (BYO-HSM+dedicated-control-plane) (tomorrow AM). 4) sophie prep procurement one-pager.
maya_sales: I'll keep customer warm and propose a quick 30-min call once we have docs. :handshake:
